headline: Accuses Iran of fabricating Hormuz tanker hits/mines ('fake hits, mines') to drive up oil before the Nov 3 midterms
dek: (a) Trump's post text is VERIFIED FACT of utterance (via JPost verbatim quotes): 'Iran is doing everything they can to drive up the price of Oil prior to the US Midterm Election. They are even making up fake hits, mines, and everything else, because more Oil is coming through the Hormuz Strait now…
sources: Donald Trump (Truth Social post, Oct 22 US); Jerusalem Post report
fault_line: Trump says more oil is flowing through Hormuz than before the war — so why are Americans paying record gas prices?

sections.what_happened: (a) Trump's post text is VERIFIED FACT of utterance (via JPost verbatim quotes): 'Iran is doing everything they can to drive up the price of Oil prior to the US Midterm Election. They are even making up fake hits, mines, and everything else, because more Oil is coming through the Hormuz Strait now than it did even prior to the beginning of the Conflict.' (b) Fabrication accusation is a PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM, contested. (c) 'More oil than pre-conflict' is a PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM, contested by UKMTO (traffic 70% below pre-war; 14 vessels attacked Oct 8–17) and WSJ tracking (14m bpd = 82% of prewar last week) — all covered in totw-20261023-0300-01. (d) 'There's a price to pay, which I knew immediately when I did it... we can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon' — VERIFIED FACT of White House remarks (Oct 22).
sections.what_verified: JPost (verbatim quotes); AJ liveblog WATCH entry (00:07 GMT). White House remarks corroborated by JPost.
sections.what_disputed: UKMTO: >=14 vessels attacked Oct 8–17, traffic 70% below pre-war levels; WSJ: ~14m bpd = 82% of prewar — the flow 'more than pre-conflict' claim contradicts every independent tracker. IRGC's 7-vessel claim itself is unverified (totw-20261023-0300-01); the truth is in neither camp's number.
sections.why_matters: The Hormuz numbers war: Trump says Iran fakes tanker attacks to rig the midterms — the trackers tell a different story
